title: Secret Painting (extractable: false)
summary: A per-visit painting is encrypted under a key the page itself cannot export, and its ciphertext is hung as a black square: known only to the artist, and the artist is the browser.
mechanism: Web Crypto AES-GCM with a non-extractable CryptoKey (exportKey refused live), fixed-length padding to hide the dimension, ciphertext bytes rendered at 0-7/255 on a 28x28 canvas; nothing stored or sent.
references: y-a-v-a, Zone de Sensibilite Picturale Immaterielle (2026)
